sections.overview: It is one of five Ictiobus sucker species. It can hybridize with Smallmouth Buffalo, Ictiobus bubalus.
sections.identification: It reaches 91 cm and 36 kg; its large mouth lacks barbels.
sections.habitat: It favors slow rivers, lakes and reservoirs.
sections.behavior: Spring floods prompt movement toward spawning grounds.
sections.reproduction: It spawns in spring and scatters eggs over vegetation.
sections.ecology: Unlike many suckers, it eats plankton as well as benthos.
sections.conservation: In 2008, Canadian populations received different regional status designations.
